analyst_pushback.pushback: How sustainable is recovery and how much is Nykaa-specific vs market tailwinds?
analyst_pushback.response: Intrinsics (assortment, funnel) give confidence; delivered significantly faster than market growth

analyst_pushback.pushback: Strategy change on luxury goods and 7-minute delivery vs original plan?
analyst_pushback.response: Unforeseen benefit enabling luxury access via hyperlocal stores; complements personal care penetration

analyst_pushback.pushback: Why not more operating leverage in Beauty despite margin improvements in Fashion?
analyst_pushback.response: Beauty is mix of multiple businesses; eB2B growing faster dilutes mix overall

analyst_pushback.pushback: Risk of AOV dilution from new brand onboarding including H&M?
analyst_pushback.response: No meaningful dilution expected; Nykaa Fashion premium positioning; higher AOV than peers
